scripts.enquiries: npx wrangler d1 execute ded-enquiries --config db/wrangler.d1.toml --remote --command "SELECT id, substr(created_at,1,16) AS at, email_status, name, email, company, budget, timeline, substr(description,1,60) AS description FROM enquiries ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20"
scripts.enquiries:failed: npx wrangler d1 execute ded-enquiries --config db/wrangler.d1.toml --remote --command "SELECT id, substr(created_at,1,16) AS at, email_status, name, email, substr(email_error,1,140) AS error FROM enquiries WHERE email_status <> 'sent' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20"
scripts.rejections: npx wrangler d1 execute ded-enquiries --config db/wrangler.d1.toml --remote --command "SELECT reason, COUNT(*) AS n FROM rejections WHERE created_at >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now','-7 days') GROUP BY reason ORDER BY n DESC; SELECT id, substr(created_at,1,16) AS at, reason, email_domain FROM rejections ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20"
scripts.db:schema: npx wrangler d1 execute ded-enquiries --config db/wrangler.d1.toml --remote --file=db/schema.sql
scripts.db:schema:local: npx wrangler d1 execute ded-enquiries --config db/wrangler.d1.toml --local --persist-to .wrangler/state --file=db/schema.sql
